edges.reason: Constructor mints the whole supply to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
msg.sender is passed as the account parameter of _mint.
transfer debits and credits balances keyed by the caller-controlled msg.sender.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key for allowance checks and decrements.
approve writes _allowed keyed by the caller-controlled msg.sender.
increaseAllowance updates allowance for the caller-controlled msg.sender.
decreaseAllowance updates allowance for the caller-controlled msg.sender.
burn passes msg.sender to _burn as the debited account.
burnFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is spent.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowed mapping.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
findOnePercent reads basePercent to compute the burn percentage.
transfer reads _balances of sender and recipient before updating them.
transfer writes updated balances back into the _balances mapping.
transfer performs a SafeMath sub of value from the caller balance.
transfer performs a SafeMath add of the net amount to the recipient balance.
The subtracted balance result is written back to _balances[msg.sender].
The added balance result is written back to _balances[to].
findOnePercent computes the burn amount through SafeMath ceil, mul and div.
The burn amount produced by findOnePercent is subtracted from _totalSupply in callers.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance by value via SafeMath sub.
The decremented allowance is written back into _allowed.
_burn subtracts the burn amount from the total supply.
The reduced supply result is written back into _totalSupply.
burnFrom subtracts amount from the caller allowance.
The reduced allowance is written back into _allowed.
_mint adds the minted amount to _balances[account].
_burn subtracts the burned amount from _balances[account].
transferFrom reads and writes _balances[from] and _balances[to].
transferFrom reads and writes _allowed[from][msg.sender].
burn indirectly mutates _balances via the _burn call.
The payable constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
multiTransfer invokes transfer once per receiver in its loop.
transfer invokes findOnePercent to compute the burn amount.
transferFrom invokes findOnePercent to compute the burn amount.
burn delegates to the internal _burn routine.
burnFrom delegates to the internal _burn routine after spending allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient address parameter is only meaningful inside the transfer function body.
Amount parameter flows directly into the transfer balance and burn arithmetic.
Receivers array parameter is only used by the multiTransfer loop.
Amounts array parameter is only used by the multiTransfer loop.
Spender parameter is used only to write the approve allowance entry.
Value parameter is used only to write the approve allowance entry.
From address parameter drives the transferFrom balance and allowance updates.
To address parameter drives the transferFrom recipient balance update.
Value parameter feeds the transferFrom balance, burn and allowance arithmetic.
Spender parameter is used only inside increaseAllowance.
Added value parameter is used only in the increaseAllowance addition.
Spender parameter is used only inside decreaseAllowance.
Subtracted value parameter is used only in the decreaseAllowance subtraction.
Account parameter is the target of the _mint balance credit.
Amount parameter is the minted quantity added by _mint.
Amount parameter is passed straight through burn into _burn.
Account parameter selects the balance debited by _burn.
Amount parameter is the burn quantity handled by _burn.
Account parameter keys the allowance and balance handled by burnFrom.
Amount parameter is the burned quantity in burnFrom.
Owner parameter is only an index into the balanceOf lookup.
Owner parameter is only an index into the allowance lookup.
Spender parameter is only an index into the allowance lookup.
Value parameter is the input transformed by findOnePercent arithmetic.
Constructor name argument is written to _name during contract construction.
Constructor symbol argument is written to _symbol during contract construction.
Constructor decimals argument is written to _decimals during contract construction.
Local burn amount feeds the transfer balance subtraction path.
Local net transfer amount feeds the transfer recipient credit path.
Loop index exists only to drive the multiTransfer iteration.
Local burn amount drives the transferFrom supply and balance updates.
Local net transfer amount drives the transferFrom recipient credit.
Rounded value local is intermediate state in findOnePercent.
One percent local is the returned result of findOnePercent.
